launch.banner.headline: Everything was already in place — starting {gameName} now
launch.checking.hint: This can take a moment on a large game.
launch.checking.title: Checking your files…
launch.checks.clean: No unsaved changes in your game files or saves
launch.checks.cleanInstall: No unsaved changes in your game files
launch.checks.install: Game version and mods: already on {state}
launch.checks.installPlain: Game version and mods: already match this profile
launch.checks.title: What SavePoint checked
launch.dialog.discardMessage: {role, select, install {The game install folder} external {The saves folder} other {The folder}} ({path}) goes back to how it was when it was last saved.
launch.dialog.discardRemoves: {count, plural, one {# new file is deleted.} other {# new files are deleted.}}
launch.dialog.discardRestores: {count, plural, one {# changed file is put back.} other {# changed files are put back.}}
launch.dialog.dontAskAgain: Don't ask again when only the save changes
launch.dialog.keepExplain: Some of these changes aren't linked to a profile — they came from an older save or a profile that was removed. Keep them as a new profile so nothing is lost.
launch.dialog.olderPoint: This is an older point in "{profileName}". After you play, SavePoint will offer to keep your progress as a new profile, or to continue this profile from here.
launch.dialog.saveCaption: This replaces what's in your saves folder right now.
launch.dialog.saveSubtitle: {count, plural, one {# save} other {# saves}} in this profile
launch.dialog.saveSubtitleRecent: Most recent · {count, plural, one {# save} other {# saves}} in this profile
launch.dialog.subtitle: Here's exactly what SavePoint will change before the game starts.
launch.dialog.title: Switch to "{profileName}"?
launch.dialog.unfinishedBody: {role, select, install {The game install folder} external {The saves folder} other {A folder}} holds files from two saves. Finish the switch to carry on, or discard what's there to go back to the save it started from.
launch.dialog.unsavedBody: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} in {role, select, install {the game's folder} external {your saves folder} other {this folder}} changed since the last time this profile was saved. They'll be lost unless you keep them.
launch.dialog.unsavedTitle: You have unsaved changes from your last session
launch.dialog.versionReplaced: About {size} of files will be replaced.
launch.dialog.versionSentence: Going from {from}, {direction, select, back {back to} other {to}} {target}.
launch.failure.heldBody: Something else on your computer is holding one of the game's files open. Close the game, its launcher and any mod manager, then try again. Nothing has been changed.
launch.failure.heldTitle: A file is in use, so the switch didn't start
launch.keep.body: Everything on disk right now is saved as a brand-new profile, so nothing is lost. You can switch back to it any time.
launch.keep.partial: Only part of that was kept. {reason} Your unsaved changes are still on disk — try again, or discard them.
launch.keep.title: Keep as a new profile
launch.leftAlone.body: {folder, select, install {Your game version and mods were} external {Your save files were} other {Your game folders were}} left as they are because they belong to another profile's saved history, so nothing from this session was added there. What changed in them is still on your computer, and SavePoint will ask about it the next time you play.
launch.leftAlone.title: Part of that session wasn't saved
launch.partial.body: {saved, select, install {Your game version and mods were saved. Your save files weren't.} external {Your save files were saved. Your game version and mods weren't.} other {Part of your session was saved, and part wasn't.}} {reason} Fix that and retry just that part; nothing you already saved is affected.
launch.partial.retry: {role, select, install {Retry the version and mods} other {Retry the saves}}
launch.partial.title: Half of that save worked
launch.postPlay.body: {count, plural, =0 {Your saves folder has no new files since you started. What should SavePoint do with what's there?} one {Your saves folder has # new file since you started. What should SavePoint do with it?} other {Your saves folder has # new files since you started. What should SavePoint do with them?}}
launch.postPlay.choicesLabel: What to do with this session
launch.postPlay.fork.sub: Recommended. "{profileName}" stays exactly as it is, and this progress becomes a profile of its own.
launch.postPlay.fork.title: Keep this as a new profile
launch.postPlay.installChanged: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} in the game's own folder also changed while you played, as an update would.
launch.postPlay.move.sub: Moves the profile forward from this older point. {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is removed from it.} one {# newer point leaves it, and you can still recover it until the next storage optimization.} other {# newer points leave it, and you can still recover them until the next storage optimization.}}
launch.postPlay.move.title: Continue "{profileName}" from here
launch.postPlay.moveConfirm.message: {count, plural, one {# newer point stops} other {# newer points stop}} being part of "{profileName}". You can still recover {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} until the next storage optimization.
launch.postPlay.moveConfirm.title: Continue "{profileName}" from here?
launch.postPlay.new.sub: Recommended. Your previous saves stay exactly as they are.
launch.postPlay.new.title: Keep this as a new point in your history
launch.postPlay.olderNote: You started from an older point in "{profileName}", so this progress can't just be added to the end of it.
launch.postPlay.skip.sub: Nothing is lost — your saves stay on disk and SavePoint will ask again before switching profiles.
launch.postPlay.skip.title: Not now
launch.postPlay.title: You played for {duration}
launch.postPlay.update.sub: Replaces that point with what's on disk now. You can't undo this one.
launch.postPlay.update.title: Update "{pointName}" instead
launch.postPlay.updateConfirm.message: This replaces "{pointName}" with what's on disk now. This can't be undone.
launch.postPlay.updateConfirm.title: Replace this point?
launch.progress.hint: This can take a while for a large install, especially if a lot changed.
launch.progress.state.versionAndMods: version {version} and its {count, plural, one {# mod file} other {# mod files}}
launch.progress.stopNote: Stopping leaves the game's folder part way between two saves. Play again and SavePoint finishes the job.
launch.progress.title: Getting {gameName} ready…
launch.running.title: {gameName} is running
launch.saving.hint: SavePoint is adding what's on disk now to your history.
launch.saving.title: Saving your session…
launch.state.mods: {version} with {count, plural, one {# mod file} other {# mod files}}
